- `echo $JAVA_HOME`
- `ls $JAVA_HOME/bin`
- `which java`
- `java -Xinternalversion`
- `$JAVA_HOME/bin/java -Xinternalversion`
- `STARSHIP_LOG='trace' starship module java`
